verses.text: The Israelites traveled from Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar his son succeeded him as priest.

xrefs.text: At the LORD’s command, Aaron the priest climbed Mount Hor and died there on the first day of the fifth month, in the fortieth year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt.
And at Mount Hor, near the border of the land of Edom, the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
They set out from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
These are the journeys of the Israelites when they came out of the land of Egypt by their divisions under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.
When you sound the short blasts a second time, the camps that lie on the south side are to set out. The blasts are to signal them to set out.

verses.text: From there they traveled to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land with streams of water.

xrefs.text: They set out from Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.

verses.text: At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to serve Him, and to pronounce blessings in His name, as they do to this day.

xrefs.text: And the priests, the sons of Levi, shall come forward, for the LORD your God has chosen them to serve Him and pronounce blessings in His name and to give a ruling in every dispute and case of assault.
For the LORD your God has chosen Levi and his sons out of all your tribes to stand and minister in His name for all time.
“Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him.
“Tell Aaron and his sons: This is how you are to bless the Israelites. Say to them:

When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy objects and all their equipment, as soon as the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites shall come and do the carrying. But they must not touch the holy objects, or they will die. These are the transportation duties of the Kohathites regarding the Tent of Meeting.

verses.text: That is why Levi has no portion or inheritance among his brothers; the LORD is his inheritance, as the LORD your God promised him.

xrefs.text: In regard to their inheritance, I am their inheritance. You are to give them no possession in Israel, for I am their possession.
The Levitical priests— indeed the whole tribe of Levi— shall have no portion or inheritance with Israel. They are to eat the food offerings to the LORD; that is their inheritance.
Then the LORD said to Aaron, “You will have no inheritance in their land, nor will you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the Israelites.
For Moses had given the inheritance east of the Jordan to the other two and a half tribes. But he granted no inheritance among them to the Levites.
The registration of the Levites totaled 23,000, every male a month old or more; they were not numbered among the other Israelites, because no inheritance was given to them among the Israelites.

verses.text: I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights, like the first time, and that time the LORD again listened to me and agreed not to destroy you.

xrefs.text: So I fell down before the LORD for forty days and forty nights, because the LORD had said He would destroy you.

Then I fell down before the LORD for forty days and forty nights, as I had done the first time. I did not eat bread or drink water because of all the sin you had committed in doing what was evil in the sight of the LORD and provoking Him to anger.
So Moses was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant— the Ten Commandments.
So the LORD said to Moses, “I will do this very thing you have asked, for you have found favor in My sight, and I know you by name.”
The LORD replied to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against Me, I will blot out of My book.

verses.text: Then the LORD said to me, “Get up. Continue your journey ahead of the people, that they may enter and possess the land that I swore to their fathers to give them.”

xrefs.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Leave this place, you and the people you brought up out of the land of Egypt, and go to the land that I promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’
Now go, lead the people to the place I described. Behold, My angel shall go before you. But on the day I settle accounts, I will punish them for their sin.”

verses.text: And now, O Israel, what does the LORD your God ask of you but to fear the LORD your God by walking in all His ways, to love Him, to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

xrefs.text: He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
He answered, “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind’ and ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’
You must walk in all the ways that the LORD your God has commanded you, so that you may live and prosper and prolong your days in the land that you will possess.
So if you carefully obey the commandments I am giving you today, to love the LORD your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul,

verses.text: and to keep the commandments and statutes of the LORD that I am giving you this day for your own good?

xrefs.text: I will give them one heart and one way, so that they will always fear Me for their own good and for the good of their children after them.
And the LORD commanded us to observe all these statutes and to fear the LORD our God, that we may always be prosperous and preserved, as we are to this day.
But the one who looks intently into the perfect law of freedom, and continues to do so— not being a forgetful hearer, but an effective doer— he will be blessed in what he does.

verses.text: Behold, to the LORD your God belong the heavens, even the highest heavens, and the earth and everything in it.

xrefs.text: Now if you will indeed obey My voice and keep My covenant, you will be My treasured possession out of all the nations— for the whole earth is Mine.
A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, the world and all who dwell therein.
The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.

You alone are the LORD. You created the heavens, the highest heavens with all their host, the earth and all that is on it, the seas and all that is in them. You give life to all things, and the host of heaven worships You.
Praise Him, O highest heavens, and you waters above the skies.

verses.text: Yet the LORD has set His affection on your fathers and loved them. And He has chosen you, their descendants after them, above all the peoples, even to this day.

xrefs.text: Because He loved your fathers, He chose their descendants after them and brought you out of Egypt by His presence and great power,
So it is written: “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”
If the LORD delights in us, He will bring us into this land, a land flowing with milk and honey, and He will give it to us.
The LORD did not set His affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than the other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.

verses.text: Circumcise your hearts, therefore, and stiffen your necks no more.

xrefs.text: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and remove the foreskins of your hearts, O men of Judah and people of Jerusalem. Otherwise, My wrath will break out like fire and burn with no one to extinguish it, because of your evil deeds.”
The LORD your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, and you will love Him with all your heart and with all your soul, so that you may live.

verses.text: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow, and He loves the foreigner, giving him food and clothing.

verses.text: So you also must love the foreigner, since you yourselves were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

xrefs.text: You must not exploit or oppress a foreign resident, for you yourselves were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

verses.text: You are to fear the LORD your God and serve Him. Hold fast to Him and take your oaths in His name.

verses.text: He is your praise and He is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome wonders that your eyes have seen.

xrefs.text: Heal me, O LORD, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved, for You are my praise.
And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, because the glory of God illuminates the city, and the Lamb is its lamp.
The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise Him, my father’s God, and I will exalt Him.

Indeed, ask now from one end of the heavens to the other about the days that long preceded you, from the day that God created man on earth: Has anything as great as this ever happened or been reported?
Yet You are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.

verses.text: Your fathers went down to Egypt, seventy in all, and now the LORD your God has made you as numerous as the stars in the sky.

xrefs.text: And with the two sons who had been born to Joseph in Egypt, the members of Jacob’s family who went to Egypt were seventy in all.
The descendants of Jacob numbered seventy in all, including Joseph, who was already in Egypt.
And the LORD took him outside and said, “Now look to the heavens and count the stars, if you are able.” Then He told him, “So shall your offspring be.”
The LORD your God has multiplied you, so that today you are as numerous as the stars in the sky.
You multiplied their descendants like the stars of heaven and brought them to the land You had told their fathers to enter and possess.
